- Continuous improvement: Participate in process-improvement initiatives.
- Assist in filing GST and income tax returns: Coordinating with internal teams and consultants to ensure accurate data, timely submissions, reconciliations, and compliance with applicable tax regulations.

Required Qualifications & Skills

- A qualified CA along with 2+ years of experience in manufacturing industries
- Strong accounting fundamentals and hands-on experience with standard costing, variance analysis, and inventory valuation.
- Advance Excel knowledge with ERP/accounting software (Zoho, SAP, Oracle, or similar).
- Analytical mindset with strong numeric accuracy and attention to detail.
- Effective communication and stakeholder management skills; ability to present findings to management.
- Ability to work with cross-functional teams and manage multiple priorities.
- Knowledge of GST & labour laws, cost components, and other basic compliance requirements. .

Position Description
The CITICS CLSA Equity Derivatives team (EQD) offers its clients a wide range of products and services meeting different needs like risk management, investment return enhancement, financing, and cross-border market access. EQD’s products and services include Prime Services, Derivative Products, Quantitative Investment Strategies (QIS), and Market Making.
EQD Quants is a team of quantitative analysts who specialize in quantitative finance and technology and work closely with EQD traders, sales and structuring teams. EQD quants design and implement EQDs e-trading infrastructure, market making systems, and trading systems for OTC non-linear, QIS, OTC prime and delta one.
This role will be primarily focused on researching and designing market making and trading strategies for EQD in India and other Asia-Pacific markets. The hire will report locally to the head of EQD Quant India and work closely with (a) EQD quants in Hong Kong and London, (b) EQD traders and structurers in Hong Kong, Singapore, Tokyo, London and New York and (c) EQD developers in India and other markets. The position will report to the EQD Quant India head in Mumbai.
Key Areas of Responsibilities
The day-to-day responsibilities of the EQD Quant will include—
• Analysis of market microstructure data to identify actionable trading signals for equities and derivatives in India and other Asia-Pac markets

• Analysis of order book data to identify actionable trading signals for equities and derivatives in India and other Asia-Pac markets

• Research and development of trading models using real-time and historical trade and quote data for equities and derivatives in India and other Asia-Pac markets

• Back-testing of the above strategies

• Understanding and enhancing EQD’s trading strategies for India and other Asia-Pac markets

• Working with EQD developers and the firm’s technology teams to implement trading strategies and optimizing code

• Understanding and contributing to EQD’s trading infrastructure

Senior Equity Research Manager

Job Overview:

Looking for a highly experienced and result-oriented Senior Equity Research Manager to lead and strengthen our equity research and advisory function. The role requires deep expertise in the Indian equity markets, strong research capabilities, and leadership skills to manage a team of analysts while delivering high-quality stock research and actionable investment recommendations and monitoring content writing assignments.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Equity Research & Stock Analysis:

- Conduct in-depth fundamental analysis of listed Indian companies across sectors, including financial modeling, valuation, and earnings analysis.

- Perform detailed financial analysis, valuation analysis and scenario analysis.

- Interpret financial statements, earnings reports, management commentary, corporate actions, industry developments and regulatory developments.

- Prepare comprehensive equity research reports, investment notes, and stock recommendations.

- Monitor portfolio stocks and update views based on market developments.

- Co-ordinating and monitoring content writing assignments such as daily market commentary, analysing stock market trends, key indices, and economic events, breaking news and updates in the financial markets.

- Create in-depth articles that simplify complex financial concepts, educational content for the readers.

2. Advisory & Investment Strategy:

- Generate actionable investment ideas aligned with DSIJs advisory philosophy.

- Develop medium- to long-term investment strategies based on macroeconomic and sector trends.

- Support portfolio construction and performance review activities.

- Develop and implement investment themes and strategies based on macroeconomic, sector-specific, or market-driven insights.

3. Market & Sector Coverage:

- Track market trends, indices, and sector developments.

- Publish market outlooks, sector reports, and thematic investment ideas.

4. Team Leadership & Mentoring:

- Lead and mentor a team of equity research analysts.

- Review research outputs for accuracy, quality, and compliance,

- Conduct training and knowledge-sharing sessions.

- Ensure the team delivers high-quality, accurate, and timely research reports.

- Foster a collaborative environment within the team, encouraging knowledge sharing and professional growth.

- Provide constructive feedback and support to analysts to enhance their research skills and output.

5. Compliance & Process Adherence:

- Ensure compliance with SEBI regulations and internal guidelines.

- Coordinate with compliance teams for disclosures and audits.

Skills & Qualifications:

- MBA (Finance), CA, CFA, or equivalent.

- 7 to 10 years of experience in equity research or investment advisory.

- Strong expertise in financial modeling, valuation, and Indian equity markets.

- Excellent communication and leadership skills.
